# Teachers Arena

> A comprehensive news and resource hub for Kenya's education sector covering teacher compensation, TSC operations, national exams, and education policy.

Teachers Arena aggregates critical updates on teacher salaries, exam administration, recruitment processes, and education sector developments in Kenya. The platform serves as a central information source for educators, invigilators, and education stakeholders tracking TSC disbursements, KNEC examinations, and policy changes.

## Key Topics

- TSC (Teachers Service Commission)
- Teacher Salaries & Compensation
- KNEC (National Exams)
- Invigilator Payments
- Budget Approval
- Intern & Replacement Teachers
- CP2 System
- March Payroll
- Payment Delays
- Teacher Recruitment
- Kenya Education Policy
- Julius Bitok (PS Basic Education)
- Salary Structure
- National Examinations

## Teacher Compensation & Payroll

- [Invigilators To Be Paid Soon As PS Bitok Calls For Budget Approval](https://arena.co.ke/invigilators-to-be-paid-soon-as-ps-bitok-calls-for-budget-approval): PS Bitok pushes budget approval for 2025 exam invigilator payments via TSC
- [Intern & Replacement Teachers Warm Up For TSC March Salaries](https://arena.co.ke/intern-replacement-teachers-warm-up-for-tsc-march-salaries): Intern and replacement teachers await TSC March salary disbursement

## Education Sector News

- [KSA Concludes Zonal & Sub County Elections Of Scouts Leaders](https://arena.co.ke/ksa-concludes-zonal-sub-county-elections-of-scouts-leaders): Kenya Scouts Association completes zonal and sub-county commissioner elections

## Quick Reference & Tools

- [Quick Links - Teachers Arena](https://arena.co.ke/quick-links): Central hub linking TSC portals, NEMIS, TPAD2, TMIS, and recruitment tools
